programme.title: Untouchable ((不可侵犯))
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake. (菲成为澳门巨人黄的右手,他的手深处涉及合法和非法业务.然而,面临地下暴力,权力斗争和道德困境,菲被爱与正义之间撕裂.很快,他发现自己陷入了致命的博中,他的生命在危险中.)

programme.title: Over My Dead Body ((死尸死时四十四))
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos. (这部黑暗喜剧开始于一个不识别的尸体出现在一个住宅公寓的门上.担心尸体将把他们的公寓变成鬼鬼的公寓,这将导致房地产价值急剧下降,)

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime. (桑比娜对安德鲁的深厚爱情在他的恋爱破坏了他们的婚姻后,导致她的心碎.多年后,当安德鲁被诊断患有癌症时,桑比娜选择回来照顾她的前丈夫,尽管过去的痛苦.随着旧情绪的复苏,她仍然相信真正的爱情只会在一生中出现一次.)

programme.title: The Last Tycoon ((最后的大亨))
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war. (黑帮手陈达升上了权力的上层阶层,但发现自己被两名女性的爱情,秘密服务的谋杀阴谋和迫在眉的战争威胁之间撕裂.)

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings ((感动她77次))
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart? (爱娃在与亚当分手后,她专注于她的职业生涯,但亚当仍然想调好自己,并试图把她移动77次.泰国电影偶像爱情爱娃时,事情变得更加复杂.在这个时候,爱娃的母亲非常生病,她考虑结婚以满足母亲的愿望.亚当会成功温暖伊娃的心吗?)

programme.title: Song Of Spring ((乱马½))
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever. (一位85岁的母亲和65岁的女儿住在一起,她患有阿尔茨海默病,导致她的记忆力衰退,精神混乱和失导.)

programme.title: Raging Fire (愤怒的火)
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score (当警察开始逮捕一名毒品主,一支面具暴徒偷走了毒品并杀害了警察.检查员邦被摧毁看到屠杀后果,很快发现杀手是由恩戈领导的,一位前警察被迫进入犯罪生活.)

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate. (林清兰与骗子乌阳·胡伊合作,要求她收回被盗的钱.当他们建立了一个精心策划的骗子,夫妇在谎言,欺骗和命运扭曲中慢慢地对彼此产生意想不到的感觉.)

programme.title: Trouble Girl (困难女孩)
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life. (小在学校遭受欺凌.她的母亲认为她是一个麻烦者,而她的父亲在国外劳动.唯一的安慰来自她的同情教师保罗.在台风期间,小发现了她母亲和保罗之间的秘密,解开了复杂的情绪和生活中的共同无助.)

programme.title: Table for Six 2 ((还是觉得你最好2))
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved. (布纳德和在婚礼期间结婚,但婚礼却变成了混乱的战场,家庭剧情不断升级,为所有参与者造成混乱的事件.)

programme.title: Love For All Seasons (爱情是每一个季节)
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending? (梅是艾尔梅宗派的代理领导者,她治愈了富裕的玩乐男孩虎的不可治愈的疾病.在她老人的威胁下,梅寻求老虎的帮助,以经历心碎和掌握心碎剑风格,以击败她的老人和维护艾尔梅宗派.)

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong ((血溅塘西))
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun. (警官和三方领袖团结起来取数十亿美元的. 作为一个律师加入他的朋友在ICAC调查他们的勾结和打击腐败,正义人和邪恶之间的战斗刚刚开始.)

programme.title: One More Chance (另一个机会)
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams. (博成的Fai被他的前女朋友委托照顾他们的自闭症儿子.从一个混乱的父亲-儿子关系开始,逐渐变成了相互赎回的旅程,帮助他重新发现自己.)

programme.title: Customs Frontline ((海关战线))
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home. (香港海关官员发现在国际冲突相关的货运船上非法武器.)

programme.title: Little Hero ((小小英雄))
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang. (小子是一个孤儿,被一个隐士接管并训练为战士.小子长大时,他觉得自己已经够大去找父母.幸运的是,他与一个乞交朋友,Hsiao Yi,他是街头聪明的人,他设法帮助他找到他的家人,但以某种方式遇到了帮派的麻烦.)

programme.title: Tiger Killer ((轰天大对决))
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them. (被任命为首席警官,在喝醉时用空手杀死一只老虎.他兄弟达兰的妻子勾引达兰,但被他拒绝,并与一个富人发生了情侣关系.他发现他们的情侣关系时,他们毒害达兰.为了报复他的兄弟的死亡,达兰杀了他们俩.)

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry ((游侠情))
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father (在路上,他救了穆万埃尔和李桑南从一群暴徒中,后来了解到恶毒雷团长天莱和龙宗派之间的20年冲突.)

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude ((椰林春恋))
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su? (平安和苏是经营一个专门从事东南亚度假的旅行社的情人.,是一名学校女主人,和她的学生加入了由带领的导游. 在旅行中,一个坏的孩子李被吸引了,但苏认为爱上了,离开了. 将如何应对这种情况,并最终与苏一起幸福地回来?)

programme.title: Shaolin Temple (沙龙寺)
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs. (随着更多的人从沙olin学习武术,清法庭命令禁止它,并计划摧毁寺.沙olin的门徒决定将他们的抗议带到街头,利用沙olin的技能来制他们的仇恨,但当清军队开始攻击沙olin寺,门徒誓言要以任何价格保护它.)

programme.title: Moods Of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel. (关于一个人会去哪里去爱情或欲望的Song王朝时期的这篇文章有两个故事.第一讲述了一个恶魔般的法官,试图通过雇佣一个漂亮的妓女,诱惑一个佛教僧侣脱离自称独身.第二讲述了一个被剥削的年轻女孩,被迫在一个无私夫妇妓院工作.)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love (让我们爱上)
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like (达是一个富有的企业家的儿子,偶然遇到了幼儿园校长的女李安.他们在第一次见面上失去了理解,导致达失去钱包.他试图让她扮演他的未婚夫,以便驱逐两个不喜欢的女人)

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar ((圆月弯刀))
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect. (剑士丁与许多剑士战斗并赢得了胜利,所以他第一次失败很糟糕,并想自杀.那时他遇到了神秘的宗派领袖的孙女,并爱上了.当他们想结婚时,宗派领袖向丁提供了满月的,但他永远不会离开宗派.)

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase ((钓金龟))
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments. (剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧)

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer ((八万罪人))
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him? (一个年轻人在错误的地方,错误的时间.他冒犯了警察检查员,他被扔进监狱,即使被释放,警察追捕他,直到他没有选择,但成为真正的罪犯.只有一个善良和美丽的缓刑官站在他的身边,但她能帮助他吗?)

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion ((八国联军))
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing. (女皇西西认为拳击手声称他们开发了一种对武器不易使用的功夫,从而对八个外国国家的联盟宣战.清政府缺乏武器和良好的领导力使八个国家联盟能够击败北京.)

programme.title: Death Valley ((死亡谷))
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong. (当贾宁发现族财富将被留给他的兄弟尤龙时,他设计了他的父母的死亡,)

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star ((星际钝胎))
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other. (一个漂亮但无知的女人被外星人绑架,但没有人相信她的近距离遇见. 计划自杀以证明自己,她遇到了一个失败的侦探,他也计划自杀. 他们在发现彼此后改变了他们的想法,开始遇到奇怪的冒险,然后爱上彼此.)

programme.title: The Sword of Swords ((剑来))
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword. (剑师在死前把剑交给他的门徒林.然而,林很快发现另一个门徒也看到剑,并阴谋把剑从林那里夺走,摧毁他的家人,并使他盲目.最后,林为报复战斗,并发誓要夺回剑.)

programme.title: Surviving The Amazon ((挑战亚马逊))

programme.title: 굿 윌 헌팅
programme.desc: 이 영화의 시나리오는 50페이지 분량에 불과한 단편소설에서 출발했고, 단편소설을 쓴 사람은 다름아닌 윌 헌팅의 배역으로 열연한 맷 데이먼.1998년 제70회 아카데미상 후보선정에 최우수 작품상, 남우주연상 등 9개 부문에 노미네이트되었고, 그해 골든글로브 상에서는 최우수 각본상을 수상했다.맷 데이먼과 벤 애플렉이 할리우드에 입성하게 된 계기가 된 영화.

programme.title: 스위치
programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
